paragraphs.text: Contrary to the report of those who said David was Saul's enemy, he proves himself to be his friend.

paragraphs.text: Though he was a cruel enemy to David, yet by his great gentleness his conscience compelled him to yield.

paragraphs.text: Though this tyrant saw and confessed the favour of God toward David, yet he did not cease to persecute him against his own conscience.
